profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer, Enterprise AI at Keurig Dr Pepper | Software Architecture, Intelligent Automation & AI Engineering
profile.summary:
I'm an engineer, developer, architect, and technology leader who has spent more than 20 years building, modernizing, and supporting enterprise technology.

My career has taken me from Lotus Notes and workflow automation through web applications, enterprise integration, cloud architecture, intelligent automation, AIOps, and now Enterprise AI. The technologies have changed considerably over the years, but the underlying challenge hasn't: understanding a problem, figuring out what actually matters, and building a solution that works.

Today, my work focuses on Enterprise AI, software architecture, intelligent automation, and modern engineering practices. I'm involved in shaping AI strategy and architecture, evaluating emerging technologies, developing practical solutions, and helping teams move from promising ideas to systems that can be governed, supported, and operated in production.

My experience spans software engineering, APIs and microservices, enterprise integration, automation platforms, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, observability, Generative AI, RAG, and agent-based architectures. I've worked across Azure and Google Cloud, with an emphasis on choosing the right approach for the problem rather than forcing every problem into the newest technology.

I enjoy working at the intersection of architecture and implementation. I like the big-picture design, but I also want to understand what's happening under the hood. That means evaluating trade-offs, challenging assumptions, working through technical details, and thinking about what happens after a solution goes live.

I've also spent much of my career mentoring engineers and architects, leading technical initiatives, and working with business and technology leaders to turn complex requirements into practical solutions.

I'm interested in technology that solves real problems—not technology for technology's sake.

I believe good engineering requires curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to question established approaches. Sometimes the existing solution is the right one. Sometimes asking "Why are we doing it that way?" leads somewhere much more interesting.

I'm still a hands-on technologist at heart, and I intend to keep it that way.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Help shape enterprise AI strategy, architecture, and multi-year technology roadmaps, translating emerging capabilities into practical, supportable solutions.

Design and develop AI-enabled solutions using Generative AI, RAG, agent-based architectures, APIs, data platforms, and enterprise integration patterns.

Evaluate AI platforms, development tools, agent frameworks, and emerging technologies, assessing their architectural fit, operational implications, and potential business value.

Partner with engineering, architecture, data, security, and business teams to establish practical approaches to AI governance, development standards, security, and responsible adoption.

Provide hands-on technical leadership across software engineering, cloud, integration, automation, CI/CD, observability, and operational readiness.

Mentor engineers and technologists, challenge architectural assumptions, and help bridge the gap between enterprise strategy and implementation.

positions.title: Sr Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Led intelligent automation initiatives spanning automation architecture, platform modernization, engineering, migration, and operational support.

• Led automation implementation and migration initiatives from technical assessment through design, development, testing, deployment, and operational handoff.

• Evaluated automation portfolios and technical backlogs to identify modernization opportunities, platform constraints, technical debt, and opportunities to reduce manual effort.

• Worked across Blue Prism, Power Automate, cloud platforms, APIs, databases, CI/CD, and supporting infrastructure to build and modernize enterprise automation capabilities.

• Helped evolve automation platforms toward more scalable, supportable, and cloud-oriented architectures.• Partnered with engineering and SRE teams to improve reliability, deployment practices, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational readiness.

• Served as a senior escalation point for automation platforms and production issues, participating in root-cause analysis and blameless postmortems.

• Developed reusable frameworks, components, and engineering practices that allowed automation teams to deliver solutions more consistently.

• Evaluated opportunities to combine traditional automation with newer AI capabilities to move beyond simple task automation and toward more intelligent solutions.

positions.title: Principal IT Architect
positions.description:
Served as an enterprise architect supporting digital transformation, application modernization, integration, automation, data, and cloud initiatives.

• Developed architectural strategies and target-state designs for enterprise applications, integrations, APIs, cloud platforms, and automation capabilities.

• Established architectural blueprints for hybrid-cloud environments, microservices, event-driven integrations, and modern application architectures.

• Partnered with business and technology leadership to translate business requirements into practical technology strategies and long-term roadmaps.

• Evaluated emerging technologies and architectural patterns to determine where they could improve scalability, reliability, integration, and operational efficiency.

• Provided architecture and technical leadership across web, data, integration, and automation domains.

• Guided modernization of legacy platforms and applications while balancing business priorities, technical debt, security, operational support, and delivery timelines.

• Mentored solution architects, engineers, and technical leads across multiple technology domains.

• Worked across development, infrastructure, operations, security, and business teams to move architectural decisions from strategy into implementation.

positions.title: Information Technology Manager
positions.description:
Led technology initiatives and development teams supporting enterprise web, collaboration, integration, and business application capabilities.

• Managed technical teams responsible for application development, platform support, enhancements, and delivery of business technology solutions.

• Worked with business stakeholders to prioritize technology initiatives, translate requirements, and establish delivery plans.

• Provided technical leadership across application architecture, development, integration, and operational support.

• Helped establish development standards, release processes, and practices for maintaining reliable enterprise applications.

• Balanced day-to-day operational responsibilities with longer-term modernization and technology improvement initiatives.

• Mentored developers and technical staff while helping build stronger engineering and architectural capabilities within the organization.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Provided architecture and technical leadership for enterprise web, collaboration, portal, and integration platforms.

• Defined architectural vision and governance for enterprise web and collaboration platforms, including SharePoint, WebSphere, and custom portals.

• Evaluated and introduced emerging technologies and architectural patterns, including REST APIs, microservices, and identity federation.

• Worked directly with business units to define technology strategies that supported business objectives while aligning with enterprise IT standards.

• Led technical evaluations and proof-of-concepts for new platforms and technologies.

• Helped establish reusable architectural patterns and development practices across application and integration teams.

positions.title: Web Applications Architect
positions.description:
Designed and led enterprise web application architectures supporting business-critical applications, integrations, and digital channels.

• Defined target architectures for Microsoft-based web applications across on-premises, hosted, and emerging cloud environments.

• Designed secure API architectures that enabled enterprise data and services to be consumed through web and mobile applications.

• Led technical proof-of-concepts to evaluate new technologies, architectural approaches, and development frameworks.

• Modernized legacy applications by introducing service-oriented and microservice-based architectures.

• Worked closely with development teams to establish architectural standards, reusable patterns, and development practices.

• Partnered with business stakeholders to understand business problems and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

• Helped establish the architectural foundation that supported the organizations transition from traditional web applications toward modern distributed systems.

positions.title: Lotus Notes Team Lead
positions.description:
Led a cross-functional team responsible for developing, customizing, and supporting enterprise Lotus Notes/Domino applications.

• Designed and delivered workflow automation and document-management solutions that replaced manual business processes with automated applications.

• Supported enterprise collaboration capabilities used by thousands of users, including secure mail routing, replication, and access-control architectures.

• Worked directly with business stakeholders to understand manual processes, identify opportunities for automation, and translate those processes into working applications.

• Introduced structured development, testing, release, and support practices for Notes/Domino applications.

• Mentored developers on LotusScript, formula language, application architecture, and development best practices.

• Established a foundation in workflow automation, enterprise application development, and technical leadership that continued throughout my career.
